Messages.Author: AaronC
Messages.Body:
Can you use Kurt Densch's special multiple times in the same untap phase? In other words, if you use his ability to cycle a card, can you look at the new one and cycle it if you chose?

I don't see a reason against it, but it seems counterintuitive.

Kurt Densch
Group 3

Camarilla: During your untap phase, you may look at the top card of your library, and Kurt may burn 1 blood to move that card to the bottom of your library. +1 intercept.

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
ANY word describing timing means that the effect can only be used once. This is usually accomplished by the use of "during".

c.f. Maris Streck: "Maris can burn a blood to give a blocking minion +1 intercept."
c.f. Corpse Minion: "Vampire with this retainer may burn X blood to get +X intercept for the current action."

Neither have such a word.
